column1: # Where a weapon is when it is not in the hand. node: the body node; x y z: metres in that node's frame (x to the creature's RIGHT, y forward, z up); roll pitch yaw: degrees, applied as T*Rz*Ry*Rx; a weapon's barrel or blade runs along its own +y, so roll -90 points it down and roll 90 up. shape: the plain holster drawn there (its long side along y). Tuned from frames.
